title: DR5 Gas Dryer
lead: The DR5 pairs dials with steam. Nine cycles, five temperature selections, Steam Boost and Steam Refresh, and a moisture sensor that stops the heat when the load is dry. Backed for five years, parts and labor.

features.name: Steam Boost and Steam Refresh
features.line: Steam Boost works on wrinkles and static during a cycle. Steam Refresh freshens what was worn once and does not need a wash.

features.name: Dries to the sensor, not the clock
features.line: A moisture sensor ends the cycle when the load is dry: Speed Queen's Over-dry Protection. A cool-down then brings the temperature down before the drum stops.

features.name: Sanitize
features.line: A Sanitize cycle for bedding, towels and whatever else needs more than dry. Speed Queen says it kills bacteria.

features.name: Nine cycles on a dial
features.line: Nine preset cycles and five temperature selections, set with three dials. No menus, and nothing to learn twice.

features.name: Five years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the DR5 with a 5-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

also: 22,500 BTU gas burner; converts to LP with Speed Queen's kit, sold separately
Extended Tumble, which keeps the load moving after the cycle ends
Up-front lint filter with a filter guard
